# A sharper jungle breakpoint

Aamon benefits when the map gives him room to delay first commit until vision is broken. The current patch rewards measured second-entry timing more than raw all-in speed.

## What changed

- Creep tempo lets him stabilize earlier in disciplined rotations.
- Mid support windows matter more than isolated mechanics.
- SOFT verdict: his value rises when drafts can protect his first vanish cycle.

> Draft him when your side lane pressure buys a second wave of map darkness.
